changes: Update app checks the pinned public GitHub repository in the background, downloads and verifies the portable ZIP internally, then installs and restarts without opening a website.
The copied frozen installer acknowledges readiness before the app closes, waits for the old process, keeps a verified backup, replaces the EXE atomically and rolls back if startup health fails.
Preview resolves unique local material/color DDS files when a renamed character folder invalidates original path hashes; original game files and valid references are preserved.
Preview diagnostics distinguish unresolved body/head images from already-resolved material bindings.
The original Formatter theme, viewer and v0.3 MCD/MDL folder loading and swap pipeline are retained.
limitations: v0.3 and earlier open a website for updates; install v0.4 manually once to enable the new in-app updater.
Real frozen installer/Tk/native-reader checks ran under Wine with the native UCRT compatibility fallback; native Windows interactive visual testing was not repeated.

The live helper protocol used disposable v0.4 executable copies with a declared older version; rollback with different old/new file contents was checked in real file transactions with injected process outcomes.
Native model loading and swap worker are byte-identical to the separately validated v0.3 release; the full Blender worker was not rerun without a worker change.
Resolved textures do not imply full game shader or tint fidelity. The Speedball reference robe/headband fitting question requires its actual source assets.
Automatic swaps remain review drafts; live hair/cloth physics and character-specific fit corrections require separate model work and game tests.
